versions.changelog:
No visible changes in this version.

- No file changes were detected between version 1.0.0 and 1.0.1.
- No modifications in features, documentation, or code structure.

Initial release of EngageLab App Push API skill:

- Call EngageLab App Push REST APIs to send notifications and in-app messages to Android, iOS, and HarmonyOS devices.
- Manage device tags and aliases; create/update scheduled push tasks and push plans.
- Support batch push, group push, message recall, push validation, and statistics queries.
- Configure callbacks, upload images (OPPO), and use push-to-speech features.
- Includes Python client helper (push_client.py) and API error code references.
- Multiple authentication/data center regions supported; requires AppKey and Master Secret.
